bootstrap.block_rule: noncircular uniform block starts on full schedule; concatenate and truncate to schedule length
bootstrap.filtering: shared episode draws first, then each fixed population; missing slots retained
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles of finite paired statistic differences
bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory, conditional on the named completed population; zero inclusion is not equivalence

definitions.error: negative liability-plus-hedge P&L before trading and financing costs
definitions.cvar95: mean largest ceil(0.05 * completed count) net P&L losses
definitions.failure: no terminal value assigned to failures; completion denominator is all scheduled episodes
definitions.sufficient_history: data available at every scheduled pre-expiry decision, irrespective of realized outcome
